description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET Framework 4.7.2 is a legacy platform with no new feature investment, and migrating to .NET 10.0 LTS ensures long-term support, access to modern APIs, performance improvements, and full compatibility with the Azure SDK (netstandard2.0 / Azure.* packages).
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the Reporting.Legacy.Web project from .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET 10.0, including: converting the non-SDK-style project file to SDK-style format, updating the target framework moniker to net10.0, migrating packages.config to PackageReference with net10.0-compatible package versions, addressing System.Web and ASP.NET Web Forms/ASMX breaking changes by migrating to ASP.NET Core equivalents, and migrating Web.config settings to the ASP.NET Core configuration system.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded the project to .NET 10 SDK-style ASP.NET Core, migrated legacy Web Forms/ASMX surfaces to route-compatible controllers, moved configuration to appsettings/options, and validated build/test successfully.
